name: Cream, heavy whipping (~37% fat)
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 577.1 g, protein 20.5 g, fat 370 g, ash 4.6 g, carbohydrate (lactose) by difference 27.8 g, typical of heavy whipping cream (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: Same conversion method as cow-milk-whole, with the sucrose elemental profile used for lactose. Cream is the fat-concentrated separation product of whole milk, reflected in its much higher C and H share relative to milk.
